text:
Priya: Welcome @Jordan! Quick checklist for new manager leads this week — dropping a short ops checklist. Ping here if anything is blocked.

Jordan: Thanks! Couple quick things: laptop ETA? access to prod dashboard? who should I add to my 1:1 list?

Priya: Laptop shipped yesterday (tracking 1Z9999... link via DM). For prod access start with corp SSO + submit the IT request form. Add @Sam and @Kevin to your 1:1s — Sam will coordinate team intros.

Maria (IT): Hey @Jordan — submit this form: https://internal.redwood.io/it-requests
Command to request onboarding bundle: 
```
/request-asset --type laptop --spec m2 --user jordan
```
MFA: enroll in Duo -> Settings -> Devices. Ping me if you hit any errors.

Kevin (Security): Heads up — before we can grant prod roles you need to finish Security 101 and Phishing 101 (approx 25 min each). Link: https://learning.redwood.io/security-101
Also sign the access agreement: /sig access-manager — we can't approve elevated roles without it. :shield:

Sam: I'll send recurring 1:1 invites and a team intro block on Day 1 (30m). Happy to run through roadmap and handoff docs on Day 2.

Jordan: One more quick ask: what should I prioritize setting with my manager for week 1?

Priya: Suggested first-week agenda (short bullets to keep momentum):
- Day 0: HR + device + accounts check (IT ticket + Duo)
- Day 1: Team intros, owner list, quick stack tour (30–60m)
- Day 2: Shadow support/ops on-call + infra runbook overview
- Day 3: Meet product & PMs, draft 30/60/90 goals (use template)
- Day 4: Sync on success metrics, set 1st month OKRs
Template: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/manager-30-60-90 — keep goals measurable and timeboxed.

onboarding-bot: New-hire welcome kit created for Jordan. Welcome :tada:

Maria (IT): Note: if you need specific service privileges, include service names and business justification in the IT form (example: 'k8s-prod: read-only for logs; support ticket #1234').

Kevin (Security): Tip — enroll Okta/SSO on your phone before the laptop arrives to reduce friction. Also, enable device disk encryption when you set up the laptop.

Jordan: Filing the IT request now and starting the training. Will update this thread once laptop + access are done. Thanks everyone!

Priya: Awesome — if anything stalls, call out blockers here and we'll escalate. We'll also run a 30/60/90 calibration at the end of week 4 to align expectations. :calendar:
filetype_note: Slack thread: messages are a single continuous string; messages prefixed with sender names per agents.md
